Results are the techniques directly detected by matching active strategies in that snapshot. IDs and availability vary by domain/version. Search accepts spaces and literal punctuation, ignores case and trims outer whitespace only for comparison. A release with no strategy objects has no matches; a newer dataset is never borrowed. The index uses active direct detects relationships from x-mitre-detection-strategy. Revoked/deprecated strategies and relationships are excluded. It searches the strategy's own name, ID and Description, rather than just analytic log-source names. Existing Data Sources search remains separate. The sidebar, Flat/Side/Mini, Select… → Search matches, and filtered SVG/Excel projections share the field preference. Save/reopen, duplication, Navigator extensions and session recovery retain it. Detections library search also includes Description; the TTP field controls stay hidden in library categories.

title: Save Individual Parent Expansion
text: Save Individual Parent Expansion# Click a parent's arrow to open or close its children in one tactic. This now saves its showSubtechniques state and marks the file unsaved. It does not select techniques or modify their annotation/state fields. Example: Choose Expand all, then close one parent under Execution. The expansion dropdown changes to Per-technique · saved. That parent stays closed under Execution while its other tactic occurrences and other families keep their states. Switch Flat → Side → Mini, search and clear, Save and reopen: the individual open/closed states return. When leaving a global all/none/annotated policy, the program first records its per-parent/tactic states, including families outside the current platform filter, then edits only the clicked family. This avoids closing unrelated families when changing modes. A required scoped row copies inherited global annotations before adding the expansion flag, preserving comments, score, color, links, Metadata and enabled state. Expansion-only structural parents remain grouping-only. Search can temporarily open a matching family; this automatic expansion is not saved or marked dirty. Clearing search restores stored states. Manual arrow changes during a search are intentional saved edits, while other temporary search expansions are not captured. Mini honors explicit closed flags; its legacy open default applies where no per-row flag exists. Global Expand all/Collapse all/Expand annotated still replace the active policy. The Per-technique choice returns to stored row settings. Flags survive layer switching, duplication, Studio/Navigator exchange and recovery. SVG expanded-only export uses the captured view, or saved per-family states if no view snapshot is supplied. Default SVG and Excel exports still include all matching children.

title: Ctrl / Cmd / Shift Mouse Selection
text: Ctrl / Cmd / Shift Mouse Selection# Matrix action Result Left-click a label/cell Replace inclusion with the clicked technique and any linked occurrences Ctrl / Cmd / Shift + left-click Toggle the clicked technique and linked occurrences in the current selection Flat checkbox without modifiers Keep the existing additive checkbox behavior Parent branch arrow Edit expansion only Double-click Open details Shift toggles membership; it does not select an alphabetical range. The clicked occurrence decides whether the linked group is added or removed, so removing an already-selected parent cannot accidentally add unselected children. Cross-tactic, family and visible-only preferences still apply. With visible-only enabled, collapsed/filtered relatives cannot be added through linking. Colors, scores, comments and enabled states stay unchanged. The TTP sidebar and keyboard checkbox workflow retain their existing behavior. Example: Click technique A, Ctrl-click B to keep both, then Shift-click B to remove B. Ordinary-click C to replace the current selection with C. With cross-tactic selection Off, only the clicked tactic occurrence is targeted.

title: Hover and Copy Source STIX / TAXII JSON
text: Hover and Copy Source STIX / TAXII JSON# Open a technique, sub-technique, actual tactic or library object detail page. Two buttons appear above the description: Copy STIX JSON copies the complete original source object. Copy TAXII envelope copies a locally generated TAXII 2.1 wrapper containing that one object. Hover over either button for about 300 ms. A small read-only window shows the corresponding JSON, with the object's STIX ID, domain and release. Move into the window to scroll through long objects. Click Copy complete JSON there or the original button, then paste into a text editor or another tool. Leaving the buttons and popup dismisses the window after a short delay. Switching objects/pages resets the preview and cached JSON so the previous object cannot be copied accidentally. The popup is constrained to the available screen and does not activate an editing window. Example: Browse a technique, hover Copy STIX JSON and inspect external_references, kill_chain_phases and custom x_mitre_* fields. Click, open a text editor and paste. The content contains source data, including fields omitted from the formatted detail page; Studio comments/colors and current TTP selections are not injected into it. For TAXII mode the shape is: jsonCopy{ "objects": [ { "type": "attack-pattern", "id": "attack-pattern--...", "name": "..." } ], "more": false } This example abbreviates the object; the clipboard includes it in full. The wrapper follows the TAXII 2.1 envelope. It is built from the loaded local snapshot, not downloaded from a TAXII server. It includes one object version and no separate relationship, marking or other dependency objects; it is not a complete dependency Bundle. Other services may require authentication, permissions, dependencies or a different import format. No network upload or TAXII synchronization takes place. Copy uses the browsed object's domain/version, including cross-domain links. Platform/index/library-heading pages and synthetic historical tactics have no original STIX object and hide the buttons. Unicode, nested fields, references and custom properties remain intact. JSON preview/copy never changes source Bundles or the selected document.

title: Progress and Verification
text: Progress and Verification# Operations report in-memory inputs and no direct output files before search, gesture, expansion, preview and clipboard stages. Expansion edits validate a complete draft before replacing the layer. Clipboard serialization failures preserve the previous clipboard text. File Save/Export/Session operations announce absolute final/temporary paths before their existing atomic publication stages. Run from the project root after installing dependencies: powershellCopy$env:QT_QPA_PLATFORM = 'offscreen' .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B .\audit_detection_interaction.py Seven stages check real official/isolated detection mappings, actual native mouse clicks in all layouts, individual expansion/inherited annotations, scrollable hover/clipboard/paste behavior, and Studio/Navigator/session/SVG/CSV round trips. Absolute inputs/outputs are announced first. Fixtures, example files, screenshots and audit.json go to <project-root>/artifacts/detection-interaction; official snapshot pointers are checked for preservation. See startup and program flow, selection/search, matrix display and saving/recovery.

title: 操作總覽
text: Fusion Studio 操作手冊# A community toolkit for MITRE ATT&CK® and ATLAS 從 Info → Manual 或 F1 開啟本頁。Manual 與檔案名稱、Technique Details 位於同一排分頁；可自由切換、關閉並重新開啟。重複點擊 Manual 會回到同一個手冊分頁。 左側「大綱與條目」可直接跳到章節。頁面內的指南連結會在這個分頁內開啟，並更新左側大綱；「開啟功能」連結會前往程式目前文件的實際操作入口。上方可回手冊首頁、瀏覽全部指南，或搜尋目前頁面文字。 預設介面與手冊為英文。使用 設定 → 語言 → 繁體中文（臺灣） 即時切換全程式介面與手冊，選擇 English 可切回英文，重新啟動後仍會保留選擇。語言切換不會變更文件名稱、選取、註記、分數、公式、來源 ID 或已儲存的檔案；ATT&CK 原始內容與官方日誌摘錄保留來源語言。

title: 1. 建立、開啟與儲存文件
text: 1. 建立、開啟與儲存文件# 使用 File → New File 建立獨立文件。 使用 File → Open Studio JSON… 開啟既有完整 Studio 文件。 使用 Save / Save As… 保存選取、註記、圖層與來源版本。 每個檔案分頁各自保存；名稱後的 * 表示尚未儲存。 一般啟動會自動還原上次有效工作階段，不再詢問。載入完成後，下方 Output 操作紀錄會提醒已還原分頁數、含未儲存變更的分頁數與復原檔路徑。 完整操作：文件儲存、關閉與復原 · English 開啟功能：選擇 Studio 文件 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: File → Open Studio JSON…

title: 2. 選擇資料版本與領域
text: 2. 選擇資料版本與領域# 目前預設使用 ATT&CK v20.0，涵蓋 Enterprise、Mobile、ICS。舊文件仍採用其儲存的資料版本；開啟舊文件不會自動升版。 點擊上方 Version (vX.Y) 可選版本。檔案分頁的右鍵選單可切換 ATT&CK Domain。首次使用未下載版本需要網路，已驗證的本機快照可離線讀取。 開啟功能：資料版本選擇器 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Version (vX.Y) · 完整操作：資料與文件

title: 3. 搜尋與選取 TTP
text: 3. 搜尋與選取 TTP# 在左側 TTP 類別搜尋名稱或 ID；TTP search fields… 可指定 Description、Data Sources、Detection Strategy 等欄位。勾選技術即可加入目前文件。矩陣中的一般點擊與 Ctrl / Shift 點擊有不同選取行為。 選取偏好可設定跨戰術連動、父子技術家族連動與僅選可見項目。切換偏好會影響之後的操作，不會自動擴大先前的選取。 開啟功能：TTP 搜尋 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: TTP sidebar → Search · 開啟功能：已選技術清單 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Workplace → Selected TTPs 完整操作：選取偏好與進階搜尋 · 矩陣互動與來源複製

title: 4. 瀏覽組織、軟體與偵測資料
text: 4. 瀏覽組織、軟體與偵測資料# 左側可切換 Groups、Software、Campaigns、Mitigations、Assets、Detections。Group／Software／Campaign／Mitigation／Asset／Detection Strategy／Data Component／Data Source 支援關聯選取及結果聯集批次，Analytics 仍僅供瀏覽。滑過下拉／完成清單的來源結果，可暫時標示對應矩陣技術。側欄的 Show matrix preview（顯示矩陣預覽） 可保留來源列表並在右側預覽；移開後還原，不更動選取或註記。 完整操作：來源搜尋與右鍵動作 · English 來源結果批次操作 · 懸停預覽手冊

title: 5. 矩陣顯示與圖層設定
text: 5. 矩陣顯示與圖層設定# Open ATT&CK Matrix 開啟原生矩陣，可使用 Flat / Side / Mini 版面、平台篩選與技術家族展開。Navigator → Layer settings… 可編輯名稱、說明、漸層、圖例、顯示設定與自訂右鍵網址。 開啟功能：ATT&CK 矩陣 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Open ATT&CK Matrix · 開啟功能：圖層設定 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Navigator → Layer settings… 完整操作：Navigator 進階流程 · 矩陣標籤與註記提示 · 可見選取與展開

title: 6. 註記、分數與批次編輯
text: 6. 註記、分數與批次編輯# 技術可以有 Comment、Score、Color、Links、Metadata 與 Enabled 狀態。技術是否被選取，與其 Enabled 狀態是獨立概念。依操作範圍可編輯全部戰術或特定戰術的技術出現位置。 先選取技術，再使用 Navigator → Batch edit selected TTPs…。對話框內確認範圍，套用才會提交；取消會保留原有內容。 完整操作：獨立狀態與批次操作 · English 開啟功能：批次編輯已選技術 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Navigator → Batch edit selected TTPs…（需先選取技術，且文件版本支援 Navigator。）

title: 7. 公式分析、聚合與比較
text: 7. 公式分析、聚合與比較# 分數公式可組合多份開啟文件的資料，建立新的分析圖層。公式語法預設 Navigator scalar，支援常數、三角函式、容差比較與連續比較；選 Studio scalar 可保留舊有捨入及運算子規則，完整手冊另說明差異與 Studio 專用的 nthRoot 擴充。計算模式預設 Studio；改選 Navigator 可採空變數常數探測、缺分補零、全部缺分略過，並納入停用來源的既有分數；此時語法固定，Studio 政策控制停用。使用前另行確認屬性繼承，自動漸層預設跟隨計算模式：Navigator 使用實際結果上下限、0–1 透明白／藍色階，常數／空結果保留 0–100。仍可選 Studio，指定 Score gradient 來源則優先於自動設定。Parent / sub-technique 聚合是分析設定，不會自動加入技術選取。 開啟功能：分數公式 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Navigator → Layer score formula · 開啟功能：比較文件 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Navigator → Compare documents · 開啟功能：比較 ATT&CK 版本 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Compare ATT&CK versions 完整操作與範例：圖層分數公式 · 聚合與匯出 完整操作：SVG 紙張尺寸與方向 完整操作：SVG 淺色／深色匯出主題

title: 8. Navigator、自訂資料與版本遷移
text: 8. Navigator、自訂資料與版本遷移# Studio 文件用於完整保存本工具狀態；Navigator Layer 用於與支援該格式的工具交換圖層。CSV 是選取資料交換，無法還原所有畫面設定。 Import Navigator Layer… / Ctrl+Alt+O 可一次開啟含 1–20 層的 JSON 陣列，預設勾選全部，也可自行選子集合。各層獨立使用領域、版本、來源與選取規則；全部勾選圖層就緒才一次開啟，保留既有文件。 完整操作：多圖層 JSON 與缺少來源的處理 自訂來源缺少或不明確時，可在匯入預覽按 解析自訂資料…，取得指定網址、驗證本機 Bundle／快取或選擇 Collection Index 版本。確認確切雜湊、領域及版本後才綁定該層；資料集變更須明確同意取代。單純開啟來源視窗不會下載。 完整操作：customDataURL 取得與來源變更檢視 自訂資料需是 ATT&CK-compatible STIX Bundle 或 Collection Index。匯入後先確認來源、領域與版本。升版請使用逐項審閱遷移，檢查被撤銷、替代或無法對應的技術。 自訂 Bundle 現可加入額外領域，分別設定顯示名稱、Kill Chain 與外部 ID 來源。先在來源預覽選領域，再透過檔案分頁右鍵 ATT&CK Domain 在同一資料集中切換。多份 Matrix 使用有序聯集；Studio、Navigator、CSV 與復原均保留自訂識別及各領域狀態。 完整操作與可載入範例：自訂 Domain 完整操作：升級最後摘要、略過理由與返回未完成項目 開啟功能：匯入 Navigator Layer — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Import Navigator Layer… / Ctrl+Alt+O · 開啟功能：URL／自訂 STIX — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: File → Load layer URL / custom STIX… · 開啟功能：審閱圖層升版 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Navigator → Review and upgrade layer… 完整操作：自訂資料與審閱升版

title: 9. 匯出與分享
text: 9. 匯出與分享# File → Export… / Export CSV… / Export Navigator Layer… 匯出交換資料。Navigator → Export matrix SVG… / Export matrix Excel… 匯出矩陣成果；多圖層 Excel 可將每份開啟文件輸出為個別工作表。 開啟功能：匯出 SVG 設定 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Navigator → Export matrix SVG… · 開啟功能：匯出 Excel 設定 — 請在 Fusion Studio 桌面程式操作: Navigator → Export matrix Excel… 完整操作：匯出範圍、聚合與範例 Navigator JSON 匯出會檢視各圖層隱藏但已修改的註記格子。只匯出可見技術的註記 預設不勾選，完整保留全部註記。作用中矩陣依篩選／搜尋／展開判定可見性，其他圖層依各自保存的畫面設定。精簡副本仍保留 Studio 納入標記、完整圖層屬性與選取範圍。取消不寫檔，原註記、名稱及未儲存狀態均不變。 完整操作：JSON 註記匯出選項與隱藏範圍提醒

title: 10. 進度、錯誤與復原
text: 10. 進度、錯誤與復原# 檔案操作會先顯示輸入／輸出絕對路徑，並於各階段顯示進度。請等候完成訊息。儲存／匯出失敗時先閱讀下方 Output，不要把未完成檔案當成成功結果。 Session checkpoint 可協助復原工作階段，但仍應主動儲存 Studio 文件。手冊為唯讀參考分頁，不會加入選取集合或成為匯出圖層；其開啟狀態不另存入 Studio 文件。 完整操作：Session 復原與失敗保護

title: 11. 作者與官方資源
text: 11. 作者與官方資源# Info 內可查看作者資訊、MITRE 簡介、ATT&CK 簡介與版本更新紀錄。滑鼠懸停 Version update history 可展開版本列表；點擊版本閱讀短摘錄，再由網址開啟完整官方更新日誌。 全部中英文操作指南 · 安裝與啟動說明 · MITRE ATT&CK 官方網站

title: CAR 研究內容
text: CAR 研究內容# CAR 分析、CAR 資料模型與 CAR 感測器導覽圖示只開側邊清單；選好後透過 Workplace → 開啟 CAR 完整介面 開啟完整頁。分析可獨立納入目前 Workplace；請用 Studio JSON 與預設勾選的 CAR 內容選項完整保存。Navigator 僅保存 TTP。CAR 操作手冊。

title: 工作區頁籤與側邊欄顯示
text: 工作區頁籤與側邊欄顯示# ATLAS 案例詳細頁位於上層參考頁籤，搜尋／清單位於左側。Workplace → 開啟 ATLAS 緩解措施詳細資料 不需先選項目；點緩解措施圖示／清單不切換右頁。Settings → 側邊欄顯示提供 ATT&CK、ATLAS、CAR 三個獨立開關，預設全開，Workplace 永遠保留。全部收合選取清單時，摘要與控制列維持正常高度。 操作說明. CAR 瀏覽器 與 Technique Details 並列為上層獨立參考頁籤，可用 × 或右鍵關閉，再由 Workplace 開啟；Recovery 保存頁籤是否開啟、目前頁面及類別。另見工作區操作說明。

title: Operating manual
text: Fusion Studio Operating Manual# A community toolkit for MITRE ATT&CK® and ATLAS Open Info → Manual or press F1. Manual is a reference tab alongside your file names and Technique Details. Opening it again focuses the same tab; switching or closing it retains your current document. Use the outline on the left to jump to sections. Guide links open inside this tab and update the outline. Open feature links open the actual control for the active document. The toolbar opens the home page or guide index and searches the current page. English is the default. Choose Settings → Language → 繁體中文（臺灣） to switch the interface and manual immediately. Choose English to switch back. Your choice is remembered after restart. Language changes preserve document names, selections, comments, scores, formulas, source IDs and saved file contents. Original ATT&CK content and official release excerpts retain their source language.

title: 1. Create, open and save documents
text: 1. Create, open and save documents# Use File → New File to create an independent document. Use File → Open Studio JSON… to restore a complete Studio document. Use Save / Save As… to save selections, annotations, layer settings and dataset identity. Files save independently; an asterisk after a name indicates unsaved changes. Normal startup automatically restores the last valid session without a confirmation question. The bottom Output panel reports the restored tab and unsaved-tab counts and checkpoint path when loading completes. Guide: Studio files, closing and recovery · Open feature: choose a Studio document — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: File → Open Studio JSON…

title: 2. Choose an ATT&CK version and domain
text: 2. Choose an ATT&CK version and domain# The current default is ATT&CK v20.0, with Enterprise, Mobile and ICS data. Existing documents keep their recorded dataset; opening an old document does not upgrade it automatically. Use Version (vX.Y) to select a release. Right-click a file tab to change its ATT&CK Domain. Uncached releases need a download; verified local snapshots remain available offline. Open feature: version picker — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Version (vX.Y) · Guide: datasets and historical releases

title: 3. Search and select TTPs
text: 3. Search and select TTPs# Search by name or ID in the TTP sidebar. TTP search fields… also offers Description, Data Sources and Detection Strategy. Check techniques to include them in the active document. Ordinary matrix clicks and Ctrl / Shift clicks have different selection behavior. Selection preferences control cross-tactic linking, parent/child family linking and visible-only eligibility. Changing a preference affects later gestures rather than expanding an existing selection. Open feature: TTP search — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: TTP sidebar → Search · Open feature: selected techniques — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Workplace → Selected TTPs Guide: selection preferences and extended search · Guide: matrix interaction and source copying

title: 4. Browse groups, software and detection content
text: 4. Browse groups, software and detection content# Use Groups, Software, Campaigns, Mitigations, Assets and Detections in the left rail. Group / Software / Campaign / Mitigation / Asset / Detection Strategy / Data Component / Data Source support related-technique selection and result-union batches; Analytics remain browse-only. Hover dropdown/completion results to temporarily outline mapped techniques. In the sidebar, Show matrix preview keeps source results beside the matrix. Moving away restores the original display without editing selection or annotations. Guide: source search and context actions Guide: source result batches · Guide: hover preview

title: 5. Matrix display and layer settings
text: 5. Matrix display and layer settings# Open ATT&CK Matrix opens the native Flat / Side / Mini views with platform filters and saved family expansion. Navigator → Layer settings… edits the description, gradient, legend, display preferences and custom context URLs. Open feature: ATT&CK matrix — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Open ATT&CK Matrix · Open feature: layer settings — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Navigator → Layer settings… Guide: advanced Navigator workflows · Guide: labels and annotation indicators · Guide: visible selection and expansion

title: 6. Annotations, scores and batch editing
text: 6. Annotations, scores and batch editing# Techniques support Comment, Score, Color, Links, Metadata and Enabled state. Inclusion and Enabled are independent. Editing may apply to all tactics or selected tactic occurrences. Select techniques before opening Navigator → Batch edit selected TTPs…. Check the scope before applying. Cancelling leaves the original content intact. Open feature: batch-edit selected techniques — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Navigator → Batch edit selected TTPs… — requires a selection and a Navigator-compatible document. Guide: independent states and batch operations

title: 7. Formulas, aggregation and comparisons
text: 7. Formulas, aggregation and comparisons# Score formulas combine source layers into a new result. Formula syntax defaults to Navigator scalar, with constants, trigonometric functions, tolerant comparisons and chained comparisons. Choose Studio scalar to retain earlier rounding and operator rules; the full guide explains the differences and the Studio-only nthRoot extension. Calculation mode defaults to Studio. Choose Navigator mode for empty-scope constants, missing inputs as zero, all-missing cells skipped and stored disabled scores included; its syntax is fixed and Studio policy controls are inactive. Check independent property inheritance separately. Automatic gradient mode follows the calculation mode by default: Navigator uses actual result bounds and a transparent-white/blue 0–1 preset, with default 0–100 for constant/empty results. Studio remains selectable, and a chosen Score gradient source always overrides automatic settings. Family aggregation does not automatically change the selected techniques. Open feature: score formula — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Navigator → Layer score formula · Open feature: compare documents — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Navigator → Compare documents · Open feature: compare ATT&CK versions — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Compare ATT&CK versions Guide and examples: score formulas · Guide: aggregation and exports Guide: SVG paper sizes and orientation Guide: SVG Light/Dark export themes

title: 8. Navigator, custom sources and reviewed upgrades
text: 8. Navigator, custom sources and reviewed upgrades# Studio JSON preserves the complete native document. Navigator Layers exchange compatible layer data. CSV exchanges selected techniques and cannot restore all presentation settings. Import Navigator Layer… / Ctrl+Alt+O can open an entire 1–20-layer JSON array. All layers are checked by default; use the checkboxes to choose a subset. Each has its own domain, release, source and selection policy. The batch opens only when every checked layer is ready, preserving existing documents. Guide: multi-layer JSON opening and blocked-source handling For a missing or ambiguous custom layer source, Resolve custom data… in the import preview can fetch its URL, validate a local Bundle/cache or offer Collection Index versions. Review the exact hash/domain/release and explicitly approve any changed dataset before binding it to that layer. Opening the source review does not fetch automatically. Guide: customDataURL acquisition and changed-source review Custom data must be an ATT&CK-compatible STIX Bundle or Collection Index. Confirm its source, domain and version. Use reviewed migration to handle revoked, replaced or unresolved techniques. Custom Bundles can now define additional domains with separate display names, Kill Chains and external-ID sources. Choose a domain in the source preview, then switch within that dataset through the filename's ATT&CK Domain context menu. Multiple matrices form one ordered union; Studio, Navigator, CSV and session recovery preserve custom identities and domain state. Guide and loadable example: custom domains Guide: final upgrade summary, skip reasons and unfinished-item return Open feature: import Navigator Layer — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Import Navigator Layer… / Ctrl+Alt+O · Open feature: URL or custom STIX — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: File → Load layer URL / custom STIX… · Open feature: reviewed layer upgrade — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Navigator → Review and upgrade layer… Guide: custom data and reviewed migration

title: 9. Export and share
text: 9. Export and share# Use File → Export… / Export CSV… / Export Navigator Layer… for exchange files. Navigator → Export matrix SVG… / Export matrix Excel… creates matrix artifacts. The all-layer workbook creates a separate worksheet for each open layer. Open feature: SVG export settings — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Navigator → Export matrix SVG… · Open feature: Excel export settings — In the Fusion Studio desktop app: Navigator → Export matrix Excel… Guide: export scope, aggregation and examples Navigator JSON exports review hidden modified annotation cells per layer. Export annotations on visible techniques only is unchecked by default, preserving all annotations. The active matrix's filters/search/expansion define visibility; inactive layers use their own saved view. A reduced copy retains Studio inclusion markers, complete layer properties and exact selection scopes. Cancel writes nothing; source annotations, names and unsaved states are unchanged. Guide: JSON annotation export options and hidden-scope warnings

title: 10. Progress, errors and recovery
text: 10. Progress, errors and recovery# File operations announce absolute input/output paths and staged progress. Wait for completion. If an operation fails, inspect Output before treating a file as a finished result. Session checkpoints help recover work but do not replace deliberate Studio saves. The Manual is read-only reference content; it is excluded from TTP selections and exported layers. Its open state is not saved in Studio files. Guide: session recovery and failure protection

title: 11. Information and official resources
text: 11. Information and official resources# Info contains author information, official MITRE and ATT&CK introductions, and version history. Hover over Version update history to see the release list. Select a version for a short source excerpt and a link to the full official changelog. All operating guides · Installation and startup · Official MITRE ATT&CK website

title: CAR research content
text: CAR research content# Use the CAR Analytics, CAR Data Model and CAR Sensors activity icons to open sidebar lists. Select an entry, then use Workplace → Open CAR Browser for its full page. Include analytics independently in the current Workplace; use Studio JSON for complete preservation and the default-on CAR content option. Navigator stores TTPs only. CAR operating guide.

title: Workspace tabs and sidebar visibility
text: Workspace tabs and sidebar visibility# ATLAS case details use an upper reference tab with search/results in the left sidebar. Workplace → Open ATLAS Mitigation Details also works without a prior choice; mitigation rail/item clicks retain the current right page. Settings → Sidebar content independently toggles ATT&CK, ATLAS and CAR, with all three on by default; Workplace always remains. Collapsed selection groups keep the summary and controls compact. Guide. CAR Browser opens beside Technique Details as an independent upper reference tab. Close it with × or its context menu; Workplace reopens it. Recovery retains tab visibility, active page and category. See the workspace guide.

title: 安裝與啟動
text: 安裝與啟動#

title: 系統需求
text: 系統需求# 使用 Windows 或具圖形介面的 Linux、專案原始碼與宣告的相依套件。本工具是 Python／PySide6 桌面程式。Linux 實測環境為 Kali 2026.2、WSL2／WSLg、Python 3.14.7 與 PySide6 6.12.0。WSLg 可在 Windows 顯示 Linux 視窗；僅有終端機的 Linux 伺服器仍需要圖形工作階段才能互動操作。

title: 建立專案環境
text: 建立專案環境# 在專案資料夾開啟 PowerShell，建立專案專用的虛擬環境： powershell複製python -m venv .venv & '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m pip install -r requirements.txt requirements-lock.txt 是 Windows 環境的套件快照。Linux 請在自己的 Linux 虛擬環境中使用 requirements.txt 安裝；完整安裝參考資料保存在專案根目錄 README。

title: 啟動介面
text: 啟動介面# powershell複製& '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -B '.\main.py' 程式會先顯示輸入檔案的絕對路徑，再載入指定的本機資料。請等待各階段完成。若有先前的復原檢查點，會自動還原，並在操作紀錄／狀態區提醒。

title: Windows 快速啟動指令（PowerShell 與 cmd）
text: Windows 快速啟動指令（PowerShell 與 cmd）# 完成安裝後，雙擊專案資料夾內的 setup-fusionstudio.cmd，或在 PowerShell 執行 .\setup-fusionstudio.cmd（cmd 則執行 setup-fusionstudio.cmd）。重新開啟終端機後，即可從任何目錄輸入 fusionstudio，不必手動啟用虛擬環境。fusionstudio -Check 只檢查路徑與依賴，不開啟視窗或寫入應用程式檔案。 自動化註冊可執行 powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-FusionStudioCommand.ps1，不會停下等待按鍵。安裝器先顯示絕對輸入路徑及使用者 PATH 登錄輸出，再依序驗證專案、檢查依賴、註冊一次專案目錄及驗證結果。啟動器先顯示程式、環境、資料、設定、工作階段及日誌的絕對路徑，再顯示驗證、啟動與完成進度。日誌位於 <project-root>\artifacts\launch。 原本的 ttpselecter／ttpselector Windows 啟動器與舊安裝入口已移除。如果專案目錄原本已加入 PATH，可直接使用 fusionstudio，無須重新安裝。請保留專案資料夾；搬移後，先移除舊 PATH 項目，再於新位置註冊。此 Windows 設定與下方 Linux 設定分開。

title: Linux／WSL2 安裝與啟動
text:
Linux／WSL2 安裝與啟動# 在 Kali Linux 內安裝 Python 虛擬環境支援、Qt 執行函式庫與繁體中文字型： bash複製printf 'Input package sources: /etc/apt/sources.list and /etc/apt/sources.list.d
Output package directories: /usr, /var/lib/apt/lists, /var/cache/apt
' sudo apt-get update sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 python3-venv \ libegl1 libopengl0 libglib2.0-0t64 libxkbcommon-x11-0 \ libxcb-cursor0 libxcb-icccm4 libxcb-keysyms1 libxcb-image0 libxcb-render-util0 fonts-noto-cjk 建議在 Linux 家目錄準備獨立的專案副本，並在該專案目錄執行： bash複製printf 'Input requirements: %s/requirements.txt
Output environment: %s/.venv
' "$PWD" "$PWD" python3 -m venv .venv .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt .venv/bin/python -m pip check # 沒有有效的 ATT&CK 快照時才需要下載： .venv/bin/python -B scripts/download_attack_data.py bash start-fusionstudio.sh Linux 不可沿用 Windows .venv 或 .cmd 啟動腳本。若共用 Windows 原始碼目錄，請改建 .venv-linux；Bash 啟動器在找不到 Linux .venv/bin/python 時會使用它的 bin/python。bash start-fusionstudio.sh --check 檢查依賴，--no-session 可供隔離工作區停用復原。啟動器會顯示絕對輸入路徑與三階段進度，程式接著回報資料、設定、工作階段路徑與載入進度；操作期間請保持終端機開啟。可用 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb bash start-fusionstudio.sh 明確指定 WSLg／X11。若先前設定了 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen，請先取消設定才能看到視窗。其他發行版的系統套件名稱可能不同。

title: Linux 一次性指令設定
text: Linux 一次性指令設定# 完成 Linux 安裝後，在專案目錄執行 bash setup-fusionstudio.sh。重新開啟 Bash 或 Zsh，即可從任何目錄輸入 fusionstudio。目前的終端機若不想重開，可先執行一次 export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"。fusionstudio --check 可在不開啟視窗的情況下檢查依賴。 設定會將啟動指令放入目前使用者的 ~/.local/bin，並在 Bash／Zsh 啟動設定檔加入有標記的 PATH 區塊；程式本體仍使用原專案位置。修改既有設定檔前會先備份，重複執行不會新增重複區塊或備份，不需要 sudo。移動專案後請在新位置重跑設定；其他 shell 需自行設定 PATH。腳本會顯示絕對輸入、指令／設定檔／備份輸出位置與四階段進度；若遇到不屬於本工具的同名指令或被修改的管理區塊，會在寫入前停止。 已有 Linux 快速啟動設定時，重跑新版安裝器即可遷移。新 fusionstudio --check 成功後，才會移除本專案產生且未被修改的舊 ~/.local/bin/ttpselecter 啟動器，沿用既有 PATH 區塊並保留歷史備份。其他同名指令或符號連結會保留；被修改過的舊管理啟動器會讓預檢停止，不進行變更。原本的 setup-ttpselecter.sh 與 start-ttpselecter.sh 入口已移除。遷移後請重開終端機，或在 Bash 執行 hash -r、Zsh 執行 rehash。 需要指定其他原生 Linux Python 環境時，可在執行安裝器或啟動器時設定 FUSIONSTUDIO_PYTHON=/absolute/path/to/venv/bin/python；舊的 TTPSELECTER_PYTHON 變數不再使用。安裝器不會停下等待輸入，可用於自動化流程，但不會安裝依賴套件。

title: 資料與語言
text: 資料與語言# 目前預設資料為 ATT&CK v20.0。已下載的快照可離線使用，下載其他版本則需要連線至 MITRE 官方 GitHub 來源。 介面與手冊預設為英文。使用 Settings → Language → 繁體中文（臺灣） 切換為臺灣繁體中文。偏好會存於本機設定檔，不會寫入 Studio 文件。 回操作手冊

title: Installation
text: Installation and Startup#

title: Requirements
text: Requirements# Use Windows or a Linux graphical session with the project source and its declared dependencies. The application is a Python / PySide6 desktop program. Linux is tested with Kali 2026.2 on WSL2/WSLg, Python 3.14.7 and PySide6 6.12.0. WSLg supplies Linux GUI windows on Windows; a terminal-only Linux server requires a graphical session for interactive use.

title: Create the project environment
text: Create the project environment# Open PowerShell in the project folder and create a project-local virtual environment: powershellCopypython -m venv .venv & '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m pip install -r requirements.txt The Windows environment snapshot is in requirements-lock.txt. Linux users should install from requirements.txt in their own Linux environment. The root README provides the complete installation reference.

title: Start the interface
text: Start the interface# powershellCopy& '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -B '.\main.py' The application announces absolute input paths before loading the selected local dataset. Wait for the completed loading stages. A previous recovery checkpoint is restored automatically, with a notice in the output/status area.

title: Windows quick-start command (PowerShell and cmd)
text: Windows quick-start command (PowerShell and cmd)# After installation, double-click setup-fusionstudio.cmd in the project folder, or run .\setup-fusionstudio.cmd from PowerShell (setup-fusionstudio.cmd from cmd). Reopen your terminal, then enter fusionstudio from any directory. No virtual-environment activation is needed. fusionstudio -Check checks paths and dependencies without opening a window or writing application files. For noninteractive registration, run powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-FusionStudioCommand.ps1. Setup announces absolute inputs and the user PATH registry output, then validates the project, checks dependencies, registers the project directory once and verifies registration. The launcher announces absolute program, environment, dataset, settings, session and log paths, then validates, launches and reports progress. Logs are written under <project-root>\artifacts\launch. The former ttpselecter / ttpselector Windows launchers and old setup entry point have been removed. If the project directory was already registered in your PATH, fusionstudio works immediately without rerunning setup. Keep the project folder in place; after moving it, remove the old PATH entry and register the new location. These Windows commands are separate from the Linux setup below.

title: Linux / WSL2 installation and startup
text:
Linux / WSL2 installation and startup# Inside Kali Linux, install the Python environment support, Qt runtime libraries and Traditional Chinese fonts: bashCopyprintf 'Input package sources: /etc/apt/sources.list and /etc/apt/sources.list.d
Output package directories: /usr, /var/lib/apt/lists, /var/cache/apt
' sudo apt-get update sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 python3-venv \ libegl1 libopengl0 libglib2.0-0t64 libxkbcommon-x11-0 \ libxcb-cursor0 libxcb-icccm4 libxcb-keysyms1 libxcb-image0 libxcb-render-util0 fonts-noto-cjk Prefer a separate source copy in the Linux home directory. In that project's folder: bashCopyprintf 'Input requirements: %s/requirements.txt
Output environment: %s/.venv
' "$PWD" "$PWD" python3 -m venv .venv .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt .venv/bin/python -m pip check # Download only when a valid cached ATT&CK snapshot is not already present: .venv/bin/python -B scripts/download_attack_data.py bash start-fusionstudio.sh Do not reuse Windows .venv or the .cmd launch scripts in Linux. For a shared Windows source folder, create .venv-linux instead; the Bash launcher detects its bin/python when Linux .venv/bin/python is absent. bash start-fusionstudio.sh --check checks dependencies; --no-session disables recovery for an isolated workspace. The launcher prints absolute inputs and three-stage progress, then the application reports dataset/settings/session paths and loading progress. Keep its terminal open while using the window. Use QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb bash start-fusionstudio.sh to select WSLg/X11 explicitly; unset an earlier QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen setting for visible windows. Other distributions may use different system package names.

title: One-time Linux command setup
text: One-time Linux command setup# After completing Linux installation, run bash setup-fusionstudio.sh in the project folder. Reopen Bash or Zsh, then enter fusionstudio from any directory. For the current terminal immediately, use export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" once. fusionstudio --check validates dependencies without opening a window. Setup writes an executable wrapper to the current user's ~/.local/bin, retains the installed project at its original location, and adds a marked PATH block to Bash/Zsh startup files. Existing profiles are backed up before changes; repeated setup avoids duplicate blocks/backups. No sudo is needed. After moving the project, rerun setup there. Other shells need their own PATH configuration. Setup prints absolute inputs, command/profile/backup outputs and four-stage progress; preflight refuses unrelated commands or edited managed blocks. For an existing Linux installation, rerun the new setup to migrate. After the new fusionstudio --check succeeds, it removes the intact former ~/.local/bin/ttpselecter wrapper generated by this project, reuses existing PATH blocks and preserves historical backups. Unrelated commands or symlinks with the old name are retained; edited managed wrappers stop preflight without changes. The former setup-ttpselecter.sh and start-ttpselecter.sh entry points are removed. Reopen your terminal or run hash -r in Bash / rehash in Zsh after migration. To select another native Linux Python environment, set FUSIONSTUDIO_PYTHON=/absolute/path/to/venv/bin/python when running setup or the launcher. The former TTPSELECTER_PYTHON override is no longer used. Setup is noninteractive and can be used by automation; it never installs dependencies.

title: Data and language
text: Data and language# The current default dataset is ATT&CK v20.0. Downloaded snapshots can be used offline; downloading other releases requires access to official MITRE GitHub sources. The interface and manual default to English. Choose Settings → Language → 繁體中文（臺灣） for Taiwan Traditional Chinese. The preference is stored in the local settings file, separately from Studio documents. Return to the operating manual

title: JSON 註記匯出
text: Navigator JSON 註記匯出#

title: 選擇完整或可見註記
text: 選擇完整或可見註記# 先依需求調整作用中矩陣的平台、搜尋與子技術展開狀態。 選擇 File → Export Navigator Layer…；或 Navigator → Export all open layers… 將 1–20 個圖層匯出成 JSON 陣列。 選定檔名後，檢視視窗顯示輸出絕對路徑、各圖層隱藏但已修改的格子數、不重複技術 ID 數，以及受影響 ID／Tactic 的唯讀清單。 只匯出可見技術的註記 預設不勾選，完整保留全部註記；每次開啟都會回到此預設。 只有希望此次交換副本省略隱藏技術註記時才勾選，再按 匯出 JSON。按 取消 不寫入任何檔案，也不覆寫既有目標。 此處「已修改」表示與技術預設狀態不同，不是指上次儲存後才編輯。包含分數（0 也計算）、手動色、停用狀態、註解、Links、使用者 Metadata、showSubtechniques: true 及技術列的自訂欄位；匯入的註記也計算。Studio 單純記錄納入的保留 Metadata、唯讀來源 STIX Notes 不計入。每個技術／Tactic 位置計一次，另一欄顯示不重複技術 ID 數。無法解析的匯入 ID／Tactic 列視為隱藏，依原範圍列出。

title: 可見範圍的定義
text: 可見範圍的定義# 作用中圖層依實際矩陣的邏輯顯示格子判定，包含平台聯集、搜尋、Hide disabled、全域／個別展開及搜尋暫時展開。父技術可見但子技術收合時，子技術仍視為隱藏；作為家族標頭顯示的父技術則為可見。捲動到畫面外、關閉／切離矩陣分頁、隱藏填色／提示、來源懸停暫時外框都不會讓註記被省略。作用中矩陣仍在建立時，依相同平台／搜尋控制與已儲存展開設定投影。 全部圖層匯出時，其他圖層各自使用保存的平台篩選、啟用狀態與展開設定，不套用作用中搜尋。Overlay 不會將別層註記寫進目前圖層。名稱、排序、圖層 Description、漸層、圖例、圖層 Links／Metadata 等屬性均完整保留。 只匯出可見註記時，全域註記會轉為明確 Tactic 列，避免可見位置的全域註解／顏色在重新匯入後回流到隱藏 Tactic。既有個別 Tactic 列以整列優先，與矩陣一致。隱藏但已選取的技術仍保留識別資料與 Studio 納入標記，因此可能出現在 JSON，卻不含註解、顏色、分數、Links 或使用者 Metadata。選取範圍完整保留，不會因隱藏而取消 TTP。若省略隱藏的停用狀態註記，該交換副本就不再停用那個位置。 此選項只控制技術註記，不是機密資料去識別工具；圖層屬性與自訂擴充欄位仍完整保留。Studio JSON 儲存／另存新檔／匯出、CSV、工作階段復原、SVG、Excel 的規則都不變。需要完整 Domain、版本封存及可編輯原稿時，請保留 Studio 儲存檔。

title: 操作範例
text: 操作範例# 替 T1053.005 Scheduled Task 新增註解與分數，再收合 T1053 Scheduled Task/Job，匯出 Navigator JSON。預設完整保留時，隱藏子技術的註記仍在，檢視視窗列出其隱藏 Tactic 位置。勾選只匯出可見註記後，交換副本不含該子技術註記；如果原先有選取，Studio 納入標記仍能在重新匯入時還原選取。再次開啟匯出視窗時，預設又是完整保留。 若同一技術有全域註解，卻只有其中一個 Tactic 可見，精簡副本只在可見 Tactic 列保留註解。原圖層仍保有全域註記與所有選取範圍。

title: 檔案、進度與失敗處理
text: 檔案、進度與失敗處理# 輸入為記憶體中的開啟文件、相同版本／Domain 的快取 catalog 及凍結矩陣控制，不進行網路下載。處理前，Output 先顯示輸出絕對路徑。預覽依序顯示 1/3 驗證 → 2/3 解析技術／Tactic 列 → 3/3 隱藏數量。匯出列出保留策略，再顯示輸出／暫存絕對路徑與 1/3 序列化 → 2/3 寫入 UTF-8 → 3/3 原子發布。取消檢視不建立輸出或暫存檔；發布失敗會保留原有目標並清除暫存檔。 原名稱、註記、選取、儲存基準與已儲存／未儲存狀態都不變。單層匯出成功會記住交換輸出檔名／格式，全部圖層匯出則不變更這些紀錄。核取選項只對此次有效，不另存成圖層或工作階段偏好。程式化明確傳入 visible_only=True 使用同一投影；省略時完整保留，並在操作紀錄提醒隱藏數量。 驗證：使用專案 Python 設定 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen 後執行 audit_json_annotation_export.py。測試在建立隔離 fixture、範例匯出、Studio 資料、截圖及 audit.json 前列出絕對路徑，產物位於 <project-root>/artifacts/json-annotation-export。 全部手冊 · Studio 文件

title: JSON annotation export
text: Navigator JSON Annotation Export#

title: Choose complete or visible annotations
text: Choose complete or visible annotations# Arrange the active matrix's platforms, search and expanded sub-techniques as desired. Choose File → Export Navigator Layer…, or Navigator → Export all open layers… for a JSON array of 1–20 layers. Choose the output filename. The next review shows its absolute path, hidden modified cell counts, distinct technique IDs per layer and a read-only list of affected ID/tactic scopes. Leave Export annotations on visible techniques only unchecked to retain everything. This is the default every time. Check it only to omit hidden technique annotations from this exchange copy, then click Export JSON. Cancel writes nothing and preserves an existing target. In this review “modified” means different from the default technique state, rather than edited since the last Save. It includes a score (zero counts), manual color, disabled state, comment, Links, user Metadata, showSubtechniques: true, and custom technique-row fields. Imported annotations count too. Studio inclusion-only metadata and read-only source STIX Notes do not count. Each affected technique/tactic occurrence counts once; a second column counts distinct technique IDs. Unresolved imported ID/tactic rows are hidden and listed separately by their scope text.

title: What is visible
text: What is visible# The active layer uses the actual logical matrix cells after platform union, search, Hide disabled, saved/global expansion and temporary search expansion. A collapsed child is hidden even if its parent is visible. A parent displayed as a family heading is visible. Scrolling off-screen, closing/switching away from the matrix tab, hiding fills/markers, and temporary source-hover outlines do not remove annotations. An active layer still building uses the same platform/search controls and saved expansion projection. For an all-layer export, inactive layers independently use their saved platform filters, enabled states and expansion settings, with no active-layer search. Combined overlay annotations are never copied into another layer. Names, sorting, layer Description, gradient, legend, layer Links/Metadata and other layer properties remain complete. Global annotations are expanded to explicit tactic rows in a visible-only copy. This prevents a visible tactic's global comment/color from reappearing in a hidden tactic when imported. Existing tactic rows take precedence as whole rows, matching the matrix. Hidden selected techniques retain only identity and the reserved Studio inclusion marker, so they may still appear in the JSON without comments, colors, scores, links or user metadata. Selection scopes stay intact; visibility does not deselect TTPs. Omitting a hidden disabled-state annotation means that exchange copy no longer disables that occurrence. This option controls technique annotations; it is not a confidential-data redaction tool. Complete layer properties remain, including custom extensions. Studio JSON Save / Save As / Export, CSV, session recovery, SVG and Excel are unaffected. Keep a Studio save when you need all domains, version archives and an editable original.

title: Worked example
text: Worked example# Give T1053.005 Scheduled Task a comment and score, collapse T1053 Scheduled Task/Job, and export a Navigator JSON layer. With the default complete option, the hidden child's annotations remain and the review lists its hidden tactic occurrences. With visible-only checked, those child annotations are absent. If the child was selected, its Studio inclusion-only rows still restore that selection when imported into Studio. Reopen the review: complete export is selected again. If a technique has one global comment but only one visible tactic occurrence, the reduced copy contains the comment only on that tactic row. The original layer retains its global annotation and all selected scopes.

title: Files, progress and failure behavior
text: Files, progress and failure behavior# Input is the open document, exact cached catalog and frozen matrix controls in memory; no network download occurs. Before processing, Output lists the absolute target path. Preview reports 1/3 validate → 2/3 resolve technique/tactic rows → 3/3 hidden count. Export reports the chosen preservation policy, then absolute output/temporary paths and 1/3 serialize → 2/3 write UTF-8 → 3/3 atomic publish. A cancelled review creates no output or temporary file; a failed publish preserves the previous target and cleans its temporary file. Source names, annotations, selections, save baselines and clean/unsaved states remain unchanged. Single-layer export remembers its exchange filename/format; all-layer export leaves that bookkeeping alone. The checkbox is per export and is not a layer/session preference. Explicit programmatic visible_only=True uses the same projection; omitted options preserve all annotations and log hidden counts. Verification: run audit_json_annotation_export.py using the project's Python with QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen. It announces resolved paths before creating isolated fixtures, example exports, Studio data, screenshots and audit.json under <project-root>/artifacts/json-annotation-export. All guides · Studio files

title: 圖層分數公式
text: 圖層分數公式操作手冊與範例# 本手冊說明圖層分數公式的用途、分數定義，以及如何在 Fusion Studio 產生分析圖層，或與官方 ATT&CK Navigator 交換資料。

title: 目前支援範圍
text: 目前支援範圍# 使用 Navigator → Create layer from score formula…，最多 26 份來源快照對應變數 a–z，須使用相同領域、版本與資料集。支援官方 ATT&CK v4 以上及相容的自訂資料。視窗分為 Formula and scope（公式與範圍）及 Inherit properties（屬性繼承）兩頁。開啟視窗與計算本身不寫入檔案。 表達式 範例 意義 四則運算與次方 (a+b)/2、a%2、a^2 平均、餘數、次方 比較 a>b、a>=75、a==b、a!=b 成立為數字 1，否則為 0 布林 (a>b) and (a>=75)、a or b、a xor b、not a 非零為真，結果為 1／0 條件式 a>b ? 25 : 10 依條件選擇分數 函式 max(a,b)、sqrt(abs(a-b))、round(a/3,2) 使用允許的數學函式 次方使用 ^，從右往左結合，且優先於正負號：2^3^2 為 512，-2^2 為 -4。and／or 與條件式只計算需要的算術分支。建立結果前先選 Formula syntax（公式語法）。視窗預設 Navigator scalar；若要重現先前 Studio 的計算規則，選 Studio scalar。既有已儲存圖層維持原本的結果，不會自動重算。

title: 純量語法與函式（NAV-018）
text: 純量語法與函式（NAV-018）# 兩種純量語法皆提供常數 pi、e、tau、phi、true、false。在 Studio 計算模式中，若來源表列出圖層 e，它優先代表該圖層；自然常數請改寫成 exp(1)。Navigator 計算模式會先以空變數環境嘗試常數，詳見下節。 函式類型 支援函式與參數 原有算術 abs(x)、min(...)、max(...)、sqrt(x)、pow(x,y)、log(x[,base])、exp(x) 捨入 round(x[,digits])、floor(x)、ceil(x)；Navigator 的 floor／ceil 也可指定 digits 三角，角度使用弧度 sin(x)、cos(x)、tan(x)、asin(x)、acos(x)、atan(x)、atan2(y,x) 雙曲 sinh(x)、cosh(x)、tanh(x)、asinh(x)、acosh(x)、atanh(x) 對數與微小值 log2(x)、log10(x)、log1p(x)、expm1(x) 實數工具 cbrt(x)、sign(x)、fix(x[,digits])、mod(x,y) Studio 擴充 區分大小寫的 nthRoot(x[,root])；預設二次根，負數 x 須使用奇整數根，負根次取倒數 log(x) 是自然對數。fix 向零截斷並修正捨入誤差，cbrt(-8) 為 -2，sign 回傳 -1／0／1。仍限制在實數定義域：asin(2)、acosh(.5)、atanh(1)、零根次都會失敗。新增的 fix 在兩模式都限制精度為 0–15；mod 函式在兩模式皆採 Navigator 規則。 行為 Navigator scalar（新視窗預設） Studio scalar（舊有算術／Python API 預設） 大小寫 整份公式轉小寫；SIN(PI/2) → 1 區分大小寫，寫 sin(pi/2) 中間值捨入 round(2.5) → 3、round(-2.5) → -3 取偶數：分別為 2、-2 小數精度 round／floor／ceil／fix 須為 0–15 整數，含誤差修正 round 可用 ±100 整數；floor／ceil 僅一個參數 比較 相對容差 1e-12、絕對容差 1e-15；.1+.2==.3 → 1 精確浮點比較；該例為 0 連續比較 相鄰值比較，短路求值；3>2>1 → 1、(3>2)>1 → 0 明確寫成 (a<b) and (b<c) not 優先序 與一元運算同級；not 0>1 → 0 沿用舊規則；not 0>1 → 1 餘數 %、中綴 mod、mod(x,y) 用向下取整商數；5 mod -3 → -1、3%0 → 3 % 沿用舊規則且拒絕零除數；可用新增的 mod(x,y) n 次根 拒絕：官方轉小寫會將 nthRoot 變成未定義的 nthroot nthRoot(-8,3) → -2、nthRoot(16,-2) → .25 Navigator 範例：0<=a<=100 ? round(a,2) : 0、max(0, sin(pi/2)*a)、mod(a,10)。當 a=80 時，結果分別是 80、80、0。語法記錄在 x_ttp_studio_formula.syntax；舊有紀錄缺此欄代表歷史 Studio 語意。Studio／Navigator JSON 與工作階段復原皆保留此欄；匯出結果不會要求官方 Navigator 重新執行公式。 本次以 Navigator v5.3.2 的轉小寫／運算流程 與 mathjs 15.2.0 比對，詳見可重現的參考測例。這是有限純量子集：隱式乘法、階乘、後綴百分比、賦值、任意函式、陣列／矩陣、單位、複數、物件均拒絕。NAV-019 提供官方缺值／範圍模式，NAV-020 另加入下述自動漸層政策。

title: 計算模式：缺值與範圍（NAV-019）
text: 計算模式：缺值與範圍（NAV-019）# Calculation mode（計算模式）與公式語法分開。每次新開視窗仍預設 Studio · 使用指定範圍與缺值政策。若要採官方來源分數規則，改選 Navigator · 官方缺值與範圍規則；此時固定使用 Navigator 純量語法，Studio 的計算範圍與缺少分數控制停用。切回 Studio 會還原先前選項；小視窗可捲動設定與說明。 規則 Studio 計算模式（預設） Navigator 計算模式 計算目標 已選來源聯集或整張矩陣 參照來源中至少有一份分數的有效 Technique／Tactic 格子 勾選與可見性 已選範圍跟隨勾選；整張矩陣忽略顯示篩選 勾選、平台／搜尋篩選、隱藏／停用及收合狀態不縮小計算範圍 部分參照輸入缺分 維持未評分，或明確選擇補零 缺分補零 全部參照輸入缺分 依 Studio 選定政策 保持未評分，不產生人造零分；可建立空結果圖層 停用來源的既有分數 視為缺失 仍採用原分數 真正已儲存的零分 是分數 是分數，足以讓該格成為計算目標 常數公式 使用所選範圍 先嘗試空變數環境，成功則初始化所有有效映射矩陣格子 未評分結果狀態 預設停用，可明確繼承覆蓋 預設啟用，可明確繼承覆蓋 例如 (a+b)/2，a=80、b 缺分時，Navigator 模式結果為 40；來源 TTP 即使未勾選或停用也相同。若 a、b 都缺分，結果維持未評分。未使用來源有分數不會擴大目標；只用來繼承的來源可以複製註記／狀態，但不提供計算分數。分數逐 Technique／Tactic 計算，同一技術的 execution／persistence 可有不同結果；父技術彙總顯示不是公式輸入。 空變數探測也遵守短路求值：0 ? a : 50 不讀取 a，直接將整張矩陣設為 50。此模式的單獨 e 會先解析為自然常數，即使來源表有圖層 e；e+a 因空變數探測無法完成，之後逐格運算則使用來源 e（缺分補零）。exp(1) 永遠明確代表自然常數。非常數公式的所有來源都未評分時，可產生合法的空結果圖層。 Navigator 模式依來源 JSON 列的順序投影：全域列先展開到映射 Tactic，後面的列會取代該格較早的整列。較晚的精確 Tactic 列若沒有 Score，就清除該格較早全域列的分數；較晚的全域列也能取代較早的精確列。Studio 保留既有精確列／全域後備規則。計算限定目前資料集的有效映射格子；未解析／失效列不成為新增計算目標，原來源仍保留。 操作流程：確認相容來源 → 選 Navigator 計算模式 → 輸入公式與結果名稱 → 選自動漸層模式或明確指定繼承來源 → 建立結果圖層 → 核對分數 → 另行儲存／匯出。五階段進度會先宣告輸入／輸出皆在記憶體，再驗證模式／常數探測、讀取快照、計算／繼承、完整驗證並一次新增獨立頁籤。錯誤／取消不發布部分結果，也不改來源。 x_ttp_studio_formula 記錄 mode、syntax、實際 scope: "navigator"、missing: "zero-if-any-score"、evaluation: "constant" 或 "scored-union"；Studio 則記錄所選範圍／缺值政策。Studio JSON、Navigator JSON 與工作階段復原保留這些欄位。歷史紀錄缺少 mode 代表 Studio 行為，保留原結果而不重算。CSV 保存選取結果 TTP 的註記，並非整份公式設定。

title: 公式結果的自動漸層（NAV-020）
text: 公式結果的自動漸層（NAV-020）# 在公式與範圍頁面的自動漸層模式可選跟隨計算模式（預設）、Studio · 來源配色與包含零／一的範圍、Navigator · 官方結果範圍與二元色階。跟隨模式會在 Studio 計算時沿用 Studio 漸層，在 Navigator 計算時採官方漸層；也可獨立選擇色階政策，不改變分數／範圍規則。 計算分數 Navigator 自動漸層 有差異的正分或負分，例如 20／40／80、-80／-20 實際最小／最大值，官方紅／黃／綠配色 範圍恰為 0–1，例如 0／1、0／.25／1 透明白 #ffffff00 → 藍色 #66b1ffff，上下限為 0–1 只有一個分數、全部同分或常數公式 預設紅／黃／綠，上下限保留 0–100 沒有計算分數 預設紅／黃／綠與 0–100，不自行新增分數或填色 明確指定 Score gradient 來源 完整保留來源漸層，含上下限與透明度，優先於自動政策 官方預設配色為 #ff6666ff、#ffe766ff、#8ec843ff。0–1 特例依實際上下限精確判斷，允許中間有小數；全部為零或全部為一因沒有分數範圍，仍採預設配色。最小值若為 1e-16，不會誤判為 0–1。常數 200 保留 0–100，顯示上界顏色，但儲存分數仍為 200。Studio 則保留第一個參照來源的配色，範圍包含零且上界至少為一。 範例操作：將兩個 Tactic 格子設為 20、80 → 選 Navigator 計算模式 → 保留自動漸層模式：跟隨計算模式 → 建立，結果上下限為 20–80。若結果是 0、1 的成員指標，零分透明、一分藍色。若要保留來源配色／上下限，到繼承屬性 → Score gradient → 指定來源；自動選單會停用但保留原選項，取消來源後重新啟用。手動色仍優先於分數色；明確停用的結果仍顯示停用樣式。分數先計算再繼承 Enabled，因此被繼承停用的結果分數仍參與自動上下限。 切換政策建立獨立結果，不改來源分數、勾選、啟用狀態或註記。x_ttp_studio_formula.gradient_mode 記錄解析後的自動政策（studio／navigator），inheritance.gradient 記錄優先採用的來源。Studio JSON、Navigator JSON 與工作階段復原保留結果漸層及紀錄。舊檔若沒有 gradient_mode，包含 NAV-020 前建立的 Navigator 計算結果，都保留當時儲存的漸層，不自動重算。CSV 仍是選取 TTP 的註記匯出，不含完整圖層設定。 固定參考測例實際執行 v5.3.2 的公式服務與 Gradient 類別，使用固定版開發依賴，比對序列化配色／上下限及分數。原生矩陣、疊圖與 SVG／Excel 沿用既有連續 RGBA 插值及合成，並非逐像素複製官方 100 點 RGB 繪製器。重現步驟及七階段離線漸層檢查見參考工作流程，包含原生顏色、SVG 像素及 Excel 填色；應用程式本身不需要 Node／TypeScript 套件。

title: 公式與分數代表什麼
text: 公式與分數代表什麼# 公式將來源圖層中同一個 Technique 的分數，計算成新圖層的分數。例如 a 是圖層 A、b 是圖層 B，某個技術的分數分別為 80 與 60，使用 (a+b)/2 後，其結果為 70。分數含義需要先由使用者定義；本手冊以下的數據皆為假設範例。

title: 範例：找出偵測缺口
text: 範例：找出偵測缺口# 先定義兩份圖層的評分規則： a：威脅技術清單。納入這次威脅分析的技術設為 1，其餘設為 0。 b：偵測能力。已驗證能偵測的技術設為 1，已確認沒有偵測能力的技術設為 0。 使用公式： text複製a * (1 - b) Technique a：威脅技術 b：能偵測 計算結果 解讀 技術甲 1 0 1 這次分析中的偵測缺口 技術乙 1 1 0 已有偵測能力 技術丙 0 0 0 不在這次威脅分析範圍 結果 1 可以用紅色標示，協助安排補強工作；它是這套評分規則下的缺口標記，不能直接解讀為攻擊發生機率。尚未測試的技術應標示為未知，先決定是否排除或另外處理，再納入運算。

title: 操作流程
text: 操作流程#

title: 1. 在桌面程式準備來源圖層
text: 1. 在桌面程式準備來源圖層# 依專案 README啟動程式。 用 Navigator → New layer 建立兩份檔案，分別重新命名為「威脅技術」與「偵測能力」。確認兩份檔案使用相同 ATT&CK 領域及版本。 在「威脅技術」圖層中，可利用矩陣的 TTPs from → Group／Software／Campaign／Mitigation 加入相關技術。加入清單後仍須設定分數；勾選或顏色不會自動成為分數。 使用 Score selected… 或個別 TTP 的註解編輯器設定 Score。以範例的定義建立 0／1 評分，並在 Comment 紀錄資料來源、驗證方式與日期。 對準備參與計算的每個技術明確填入兩份圖層的分數。未知值保持與 0 區別，先釐清處理方式。

title: 2. 在程式內建立公式圖層
text: 2. 在程式內建立公式圖層# 開啟 Navigator → Create layer from score formula…，核對表格中 a、b 對應的來源檔案名稱。 在 Formula and scope 輸入結果圖層名稱及 a * (1 - b)；本範例保留 計算模式：Studio，再選 **Formula syntax（公式語法）**及 Selected TTP union from referenced sources（參照來源已選 TTP 聯集）或 Entire matrix（整張矩陣）。若要採官方規則，先參考上方模式對照表。 Missing scores 預設保留未知：任一參照分數缺失／停用時，該結果維持未評分。只有明確決定將缺失值當成 0 時，才改選零值處理。 視需要在 Inherit properties 分別指定各項屬性的來源，再按 Create result layer。背景工作依序顯示 1/5 驗證、2/5 讀取快照、3/5 計算與繼承、4/5 驗證完整結果、5/5 完成，然後開啟獨立的新圖層。 核對上表的三種情況。在 Layer settings… 設定 0–1 的漸層，讓 1 顯示紅色。 以下範圍／缺值段落說明 Studio 計算模式。公式逐個 Technique／tactic 使用原始 Score；父子彙總顯示不是公式輸入。預設的 Selected TTP union 只計算公式參照來源已勾選的 tactic 範圍。未使用的變數不影響缺失值或計算目標；常數使用所有列出來源的勾選聯集。只提供繼承屬性的來源不擴大計算目標。 Entire matrix 計算所有有效技術、子技術及其映射 tactic，包括目前收合、停用或被平台／搜尋篩選的格子。一次全部設成 50 的操作：開啟任一相容圖層 → 輸入 50 → 選 Entire matrix → 保留預設繼承選項 → 建立。來源完全沒有勾選 TTP 也能使用。後續繼承的篩選只影響顯示，不縮小計算範圍。 預設缺失值規則檢查公式提到的所有變數，包含未採用的條件分支；任一輸入缺失／停用，該格維持未評分。只有明確決定未知值視為零時才選零值政策。真正的零分仍會評分並納入選取。在計算目標內，來源原始分數是否參與計算與來源勾選狀態分開處理。有計算分數的結果即使繼承停用狀態也仍被選取；未評分結果預設停用，但明確指定的狀態來源可以覆蓋預設值。

title: 各項屬性分別繼承
text: 各項屬性分別繼承# 每個下拉選單都可以選不同來源。例如計算 (a+b)/2，Comments 選 a，Manual colors 選 b，漸層保留自動設定。 屬性 複製內容 Score gradient 指定來源就完整保留顏色／上下限，優先於自動漸層模式；未指定時依所選 Studio／Navigator 政策 Manual colors／Comments 精確 tactic 註記，沒有時取技術全域列；手動顏色會覆蓋分數色 Links／Metadata 技術及圖層層級清單，保留分隔列與擴充欄位 Enabled states 逐 tactic 狀態；來源沒有對應列時預設啟用 Filters／hide disabled 平台篩選與隱藏停用設定；不改變公式涵蓋範圍 Legend 來源圖層圖例 除了自動漸層，其他預設為 Do not inherit。缺少的屬性維持空白，不會自行產生顏色或父子繼承；Studio 精確 tactic 列／全域整列後備規則和原生矩陣一致，Navigator 則採上方的來源列順序投影。來源的保留選取標記會移除。即使繼承圖層 Metadata，公式來源紀錄仍保留在 x_ttp_studio_formula。來源名稱、分數、顏色、勾選與儲存狀態都不改變；結果會關閉疊色模式以顯示自身。

title: 3. 匯出與官方工具交換
text: 3. 匯出與官方工具交換# 用既有檔案匯出功能選擇 Navigator Layer JSON，或用 Navigator → Export all open layers… 匯出來源與結果圖層。目的資料夾須存在，例如先建立 examples 再儲存 examples/layers.navigator.json。 寫入前會顯示最終／暫存檔的絕對位址，並顯示驗證、寫入及發布進度。 可用 Navigator → Open ATT&CK Navigator website 開啟官方工具，載入匯出的 JSON。計算分數與標準繼承屬性可使用；Studio 的公式來源擴充欄位是紀錄，不會指示官方工具重新計算。 外部產生的結果可用 File → Import Navigator Layer 載回桌面程式。 公式輸入與輸出都在記憶體，運作前會顯示 Input files: None／Output files: None。完整 Studio JSON 請用 Save／Save As；Navigator JSON／CSV 另行匯出，寫檔前會顯示最終與暫存檔的絕對位址及分階段進度。Studio JSON、Navigator JSON 與工作階段復原保留分數、繼承屬性與公式來源紀錄；CSV 保存選取 TTP 的註記，不是完整圖層設定。詳見文件儲存手冊與分數彙總及矩陣匯出。 公式上限為 512 字元、128 個語法 token、24 層巢狀。數值須為 ±1e300 內的有限實數，指數絕對值上限 10000，min／max 最多 32 個參數。未知變數／函式、不支援的語法、除以零、Studio % 的零除數及數學定義域／溢位錯誤會中止，不建立部分圖層。Navigator 取餘數遇到零除數會回傳被除數。Cancel／Close 會在背景工作的檢查點取消。失敗後可修正並重試，來源維持不變。

title: 其他可用的分析例子
text: 其他可用的分析例子# 用途 分數定義 公式 結果代表 比較改善前後 a＝改善後、b＝改善前，使用相同 0–100 評分標準 a-b 正值表示評分提升 整合兩組評估 a、b 使用相同指標與尺度 (a+b)/2 兩組評估的平均值 統計多個威脅的共同技術 a、b、c 各以 0／1 標示是否納入該清單 a+b+c 有幾份清單包含該技術 找出兩份清單共同技術 a、b 各使用 0／1 a*b 1 表示兩份清單都包含該技術

title: 檢查重點
text: 檢查重點# 來源圖層須使用相同領域及 ATT&CK 版本，並確認公式中的變數對應。 先記錄評分定義、尺度、證據及未知值的處理方式；空白分數與 0 不相同。 公式逐項計算 Technique；具有不同 tactic 註解的同一技術，可能產生不同結果。 「Show all layers」是視覺疊色；本手冊的公式會產生帶有計算分數的新圖層。 使用少量已知資料核對結果後，再套用到完整清單。

title: 參考資料
text: 參考資料# 官方圖層公式說明 官方分數說明 官方 Navigator GitHub 專案 English manual

title: Layer score formulas
text: Layer Score Formulas: Manual and Examples# This guide explains score definitions and native formula layers in Fusion Studio, with optional exchange through the official ATT&CK Navigator.

title: Current Support
text: Current Support# Use Navigator → Create layer from score formula…. Up to 26 source snapshots map to variables a–z and must share the domain, version and exact dataset. Official ATT&CK v4+ and compatible custom data are supported. The dialog provides Formula and scope and Inherit properties tabs. Opening it and calculating do not write files. Expression Example Meaning Arithmetic and power (a+b)/2, a%2, a^2 Average, remainder, exponent Comparison a>b, a>=75, a==b, a!=b Numeric 1 if true, otherwise 0 Boolean (a>b) and (a>=75), a or b, a xor b, not a Nonzero is true; results are 1/0 Conditional a>b ? 25 : 10 Choose a score based on the condition Functions max(a,b), sqrt(abs(a-b)), round(a/3,2) Compute using the allowlisted functions Powers use ^, associate right-to-left, and precede unary signs: 2^3^2 is 512, -2^2 is -4. and/or and conditional branches short-circuit arithmetic evaluation. Choose Formula syntax before creating the result. The dialog defaults to Navigator scalar; select Studio scalar when reproducing earlier Studio arithmetic. Existing saved layers keep their stored results.

title: Scalar syntax and functions (NAV-018)
text: Scalar syntax and functions (NAV-018)# Both scalar syntaxes provide constants pi, e, tau, phi, true, false. In Studio calculation mode, a listed source layer e takes precedence over Euler's constant; use exp(1) for the constant. Navigator calculation mode first tries an empty-scope constant, as explained below. Function family Available functions and arguments Existing arithmetic abs(x), min(...), max(...), sqrt(x), pow(x,y), log(x[,base]), exp(x) Rounding round(x[,digits]), floor(x), ceil(x); Navigator also accepts digits for floor/ceil Trigonometry, radians sin(x), cos(x), tan(x), asin(x), acos(x), atan(x), atan2(y,x) Hyperbolic sinh(x), cosh(x), tanh(x), asinh(x), acosh(x), atanh(x) Logarithms and small values log2(x), log10(x), log1p(x), expm1(x) Real utilities cbrt(x), sign(x), fix(x[,digits]), mod(x,y) Studio extension Case-sensitive nthRoot(x[,root]); default root 2, negative x requires an odd integer root, negative root takes the reciprocal log(x) is natural logarithm. fix truncates toward zero with roundoff correction, cbrt(-8) is -2, and sign returns -1/0/1. Real domains still apply: asin(2), acosh(.5), atanh(1) and zero roots fail. The new fix precision is 0–15 in both modes; mod has the Navigator behavior in both modes. Behavior Navigator scalar (new dialog default) Studio scalar (earlier arithmetic / API default) Case Lowercases the whole expression; SIN(PI/2) → 1 Case-sensitive; write sin(pi/2) Half rounding round(2.5) → 3, round(-2.5) → -3 Ties to even: 2 and -2 Decimal digits Integer 0–15 for round/floor/ceil/fix, with roundoff correction round accepts integer ±100; floor/ceil take one argument Comparison Relative tolerance 1e-12 / absolute 1e-15; .1+.2==.3 → 1 Exact floating comparison; that example → 0 Chained comparison Adjacent operands, short-circuit: 3>2>1 → 1; (3>2)>1 → 0 Write (a<b) and (b<c) explicitly not precedence Unary: not 0>1 → 0 Earlier rule: not 0>1 → 1 Remainder %, infix mod, mod(x,y) use floor quotient; 5 mod -3 → -1; 3%0 → 3 % retains its earlier behavior and rejects zero divisor; new mod(x,y) is available nth root Rejected: official lowercasing changes nthRoot into undefined nthroot nthRoot(-8,3) → -2; nthRoot(16,-2) → .25 Navigator examples: 0<=a<=100 ? round(a,2) : 0, max(0, sin(pi/2)*a), mod(a,10). An example with a=80 gives 80, 80 and 0 respectively. Syntax is recorded in x_ttp_studio_formula.syntax; old provenance without it means historical Studio semantics. Studio/Navigator JSON and session recovery preserve the field. Exporting a result does not ask official Navigator to recalculate it. This scalar subset is checked against Navigator v5.3.2's lowercasing/evaluation pipeline and mathjs 15.2.0; see the reproducible fixtures. It does not implement all mathjs grammar: implicit multiplication, factorial, postfix percentages, assignment, arbitrary calls, arrays/matrices, units, complex numbers and objects are rejected. NAV-019 provides the missing-score/scope mode and NAV-020 adds the automatic-gradient policy below.

title: Calculation modes: missing scores and scope (NAV-019)
text: Calculation modes: missing scores and scope (NAV-019)# Calculation mode is separate from Formula syntax. Each new dialog defaults to Studio · chosen scope and missing-score policy. To use official source-score rules, choose Navigator · official missing scores and scope. It fixes syntax to Navigator scalar and disables the Studio Calculation scope and Missing scores controls. Switching back restores your previous Studio choices. Settings and descriptions are scrollable on smaller displays. Rule Studio calculation mode (default) Navigator calculation mode Targets Selected source union or Entire matrix Every active mapped technique/tactic with a score in at least one referenced source Source inclusion and visibility Selected scope follows checkboxes; matrix scope ignores display filters Checkboxes, platform/search filters, hidden/disabled state and collapsed children do not limit calculation One referenced input missing Keep result unscored, or explicitly substitute zero Substitute zero Every referenced input missing Follow the chosen Studio policy Leave unscored, without creating a synthetic zero; empty results are valid Stored score on a disabled source Count as missing Use the stored score Genuine stored zero A score A score; enough to make that cell a candidate Constant Use the chosen scope Try an empty source scope first, then initialize every active mapped matrix cell Unscored result state Disabled unless explicitly inherited Enabled by default; explicit Enabled inheritance can change it For (a+b)/2, a=80 and missing b produces 40 in Navigator mode, even when that source TTP is unselected or disabled. If both inputs are missing, the result stays unscored. A score in an unused source does not add targets; an inheritance-only source can copy annotations/states but does not supply computed scores. Scores are per Technique/Tactic; the same technique can have separate execution/persistence results. Parent aggregate displays are not formula inputs. The empty-scope probe also respects short-circuit branches: 0 ? a : 50 initializes the whole matrix to 50 without reading source a. A standalone e becomes Euler's constant in this mode even if layer e is listed; for e+a, the failed empty-scope probe is followed by per-cell evaluation using source e (or zero when that source is missing). exp(1) always requests the constant. A nonconstant formula over completely unscored sources produces a valid empty result layer. Navigator mode projects serialized source annotations in file order: a global row expands to mapped tactics, and a later row replaces the earlier whole row for that cell. A later exact row without Score clears that cell's earlier global Score; a later global row can replace an earlier exact row. Studio retains its existing exact-row/global fallback. Calculation remains bounded to the current catalog's active mapped cells; unresolved/inactive rows are not new computation targets and remain in the source documents. Workflow: select compatible sources → choose Navigator calculation mode → enter the formula and result name → choose Automatic gradient mode or explicit inheritance → Create result layer → review scores → Save/Export separately. The five visible stages announce in-memory inputs/outputs, validate the mode/probe, read snapshots, calculate/inherit, validate the complete result and publish one independent tab. Errors/cancellation publish no partial result and preserve sources. x_ttp_studio_formula records mode, syntax, effective scope: "navigator", missing: "zero-if-any-score" and evaluation: "constant" or "scored-union". Studio mode records its chosen scope/policy. Studio JSON, Navigator JSON and recovery retain these values. Historical records without mode mean Studio behavior and are preserved without recomputation. CSV keeps selected computed TTP annotations, rather than the complete formula configuration.

title: Automatic result gradients (NAV-020)
text: Automatic result gradients (NAV-020)# In Formula and scope, Automatic gradient mode offers Follow calculation mode (default), Studio · source colors and range including zero/one, and Navigator · official result range and binary colors. Follow uses Studio gradients for Studio calculation mode and official gradients for Navigator calculation mode. You can choose either gradient policy independently of the score/scope policy. Computed scores Navigator automatic gradient Different positive or negative values, e.g. 20/40/80 or -80/-20 Actual minimum/maximum; official red/yellow/green colors Range exactly 0–1, e.g. 0/1 or 0/.25/1 Transparent white #ffffff00 → blue #66b1ffff, bounds 0–1 One score, identical scores, or a constant formula Default red/yellow/green with bounds 0–100 No computed score Default red/yellow/green with bounds 0–100; no synthetic scores or fills An explicit Score gradient source Exact source gradient overrides the automatic policy, including its bounds and alpha The default official palette is #ff6666ff, #ffe766ff, #8ec843ff. The 0–1 trigger uses exact result bounds and can include fractional intermediate scores. All-zero or all-one results have no range and keep the default palette; a near-zero lower bound such as 1e-16 does not trigger the 0–1 preset. Constant 200 retains bounds 0–100 and displays the upper endpoint; it does not change the stored score. Studio keeps the first referenced source's palette with a range including zero and at least one. To see the difference, assign two Tactic cells scores 20 and 80 → choose Navigator calculation mode → leave Automatic gradient mode: Follow calculation mode → create. Bounds become 20–80. For a membership result with scores 0 and 1, zero is transparent and one is blue. To retain a chosen source palette/bounds, use Inherit properties → Score gradient → source; this disables the automatic dropdown while retaining its prior choice. Clearing the source selection re-enables it. Manual colors still override score colors, and explicitly disabled result cells retain their disabled appearance. Scores computed before Enabled inheritance still determine automatic bounds. Policy changes create a new result without changing source scores, selections, enabled states or annotations. x_ttp_studio_formula.gradient_mode records the resolved automatic policy (studio or navigator); inheritance.gradient records an overriding source. Studio JSON, Navigator JSON and recovery preserve the resulting gradient and provenance. Older results without gradient_mode, including pre-NAV-020 Navigator calculations, keep their stored historical gradient without recomputation. CSV remains a selected-TTP annotation export, not a complete layer configuration. The checked-in reference executes the actual v5.3.2 formula service and Gradient class, with pinned development-only dependencies. It compares serialized palette/bounds and scores. Native matrix, overlay and SVG/Excel keep their existing continuous RGBA interpolation/compositing; this is not a pixel-identical recreation of the official 100-sample RGB renderer. See the reference workflow for regeneration and the seven-stage offline gradient audit, including actual native colors, SVG pixels and Excel fills. The application requires no Node/TypeScript packages.

title: Meaning of Formulas and Scores
text: Meaning of Formulas and Scores# A formula calculates a new score from the source scores for the same technique. If a and b contain scores of 80 and 60, (a+b)/2 produces 70. Define the meaning of each score before calculating. All data below are hypothetical.

title: Example: Detection Gaps
text: Example: Detection Gaps# a: Threat technique list. Use 1 for techniques included in this threat analysis and 0 for the others. b: Detection capability. Use 1 for verified detection capability and 0 for a confirmed absence of detection capability. textCopya * (1 - b) Technique a: Threat technique b: Detectable Result Interpretation Technique A 1 0 1 Detection gap in this analysis Technique B 1 1 0 Detection capability exists Technique C 0 0 0 Outside this threat analysis Color result 1 red to help prioritize detection improvements. This is a gap indicator under the chosen scoring rules, not an attack probability. Untested techniques remain unknown; decide whether to exclude them or handle them separately before calculating.

title: Operating Steps
text: Operating Steps#

title: 1. Prepare Source Layers in the Desktop Application
text: 1. Prepare Source Layers in the Desktop Application# Start the application using the project README. Create two files with Navigator → New layer and rename them “Threat Techniques” and “Detection Capability.” Use the same ATT&CK domain and version. In the threat layer, the matrix's TTPs from → Group / Software / Campaign / Mitigation controls can add related techniques. Selection and color do not automatically assign scores. Use Score selected… or the individual TTP annotation editor to enter the example's 0/1 scores. Record evidence, verification methods, and dates in Comment. Explicitly assign both source scores for each technique participating in the calculation. Keep unknown values distinct from 0 until their handling is defined.

title: 2. Create a Native Formula Layer
text: 2. Create a Native Formula Layer# Open Navigator → Create layer from score formula… and verify the source names mapped to a and b. In Formula and scope, enter a result name and a * (1 - b). For this example keep Calculation mode: Studio, choose Formula syntax, then Selected TTP union from referenced sources or Entire matrix. Use the mode comparison above when deliberately choosing Navigator rules. The default Missing scores policy preserves unknowns: missing/disabled referenced scores leave that result unscored. Select the zero policy only when this interpretation is intentional. Optionally choose individual source layers in Inherit properties, then click Create result layer. Background progress shows 1/5 validation, 2/5 snapshot reading, 3/5 calculation/inheritance, 4/5 result validation and 5/5 completion. A separate result tab opens. Check the three example cases and configure a 0–1 gradient with result 1 colored red through Layer settings…. The following scope/missing-policy paragraphs describe Studio calculation mode. Calculations use stored Score values per technique/tactic; displayed parent aggregates are separate. In the default Selected TTP union scope, only occurrences selected in referenced sources are targets. Unused variables do not introduce missing inputs or targets. Constant formulas use all listed sources' selected union. An inheritance-only source does not add targets. Entire matrix targets all active mapped techniques, sub-techniques and tactics, including collapsed, disabled and platform/search-filtered cells. To initialize everything to 50: open any compatible layer, enter 50, choose Entire matrix, leave inheritance at its defaults, then create. No source selection is required. Filters inherited afterward change visibility, not coverage. The default missing policy checks every variable mentioned, including unchosen conditional branches; any missing/disabled input makes that cell unscored. Choose the zero policy intentionally if unknowns should count as zero. A genuine zero result stays scored/included. Within the target scope, stored source scores can contribute independently of source checkbox inclusion. Scored results are included even if their inherited Enabled state is false; missing results are disabled unless an explicit state source overrides that default.

title: Independent Property Inheritance
text: Independent Property Inheritance# Each dropdown may use a different source. For example, calculate (a+b)/2, inherit Comments from a, Manual colors from b, and retain the automatic gradient for new scores. Property What is copied Score gradient Exact source colors/bounds override Automatic gradient mode; without a source, follow the chosen Studio/Navigator policy Manual colors / Comments Exact tactic annotation, or global-row fallback; colors override score colors Links / Metadata Technique lists plus layer-level lists, preserving dividers and extension fields Enabled states Source state per tactic; absent source rows default to Enabled Filters / hide disabled Platform filters and hide-disabled flag; calculations still cover the selected scope Legend Source layer legend entries All properties except the automatic gradient default to Do not inherit. An absent property produces no synthetic annotation; there is no parent/child inheritance. Studio uses exact tactic rows with the native whole-row global fallback; Navigator uses the file-order projection described above. Reserved source selection markers are removed. Formula provenance remains in x_ttp_studio_formula even when layer metadata is inherited. Source names, scores, colors, inclusion and save state remain unchanged. Combined-color mode is switched off to show the result.

title: 3. Export and Exchange with the Official Tool
text: 3. Export and Exchange with the Official Tool# Export a Navigator Layer JSON through the existing file export controls, or use Navigator → Export all open layers… for sources/results. Choose an existing folder, or create examples before saving examples/layers.navigator.json. The application reports absolute final/temporary paths before validation, writing and publication. Navigator → Open ATT&CK Navigator website opens the official tool for loading the exported JSON. Scalar scores and inherited standard properties are available there; Studio formula provenance is an extension, not an instruction to recompute the formula. Import external result layers through File → Import Navigator Layer. Formula inputs and outputs are in memory and are announced as Input files: None / Output files: None before processing. Use Save / Save As for complete Studio JSON and a separate export for Navigator JSON/CSV; those operations show absolute final/temporary paths before stage progress. Studio JSON, Navigator JSON and recovery retain scores, inherited properties and formula provenance; CSV contains selected TTP annotations rather than the entire layer configuration. See Studio Files and Aggregation and Matrix Exports. The parser accepts at most 512 characters, 128 tokens and 24 nesting levels. Numeric values must be real, finite and within ±1e300; exponent magnitude is limited to 10000, and min/max accept at most 32 arguments. Unknown variables/functions, unsupported syntax, division by zero, Studio % by zero and domain/overflow errors stop the operation without creating a partial layer. Navigator remainder with zero divisor returns the dividend. Cancel / Close interrupts at worker checkpoints. On failure, correct the input and retry; sources remain unchanged.

title: Other Analysis Examples
text: Other Analysis Examples# Purpose Score definition Formula Interpretation Before/after comparison a = after, b = before; same 0–100 scoring rules a-b Positive values indicate improvement Combine two assessments Same metric and scale in a and b (a+b)/2 Mean assessment score Count shared threat techniques Each of a, b, c uses 0/1 list membership a+b+c Number of lists containing a technique Identify common techniques Both a and b use 0/1 membership a*b 1 means membership in both lists

title: Verification Checklist
text: Verification Checklist# Match source domains/ATT&CK versions and verify variable assignments. Document score definitions, scales, evidence, and unknown-value handling. Unscored and 0 are different. Calculations are per technique; separate tactic annotations can yield different results. Show all layers blends displayed colors. Formula calculations generate a new layer containing computed scores. Verify a small known dataset before processing a full list.

text: 矩陣顯示與註記提示# 啟動方式見專案 README。本功能適用於 Enterprise、Mobile、ICS 與自訂 ATT&CK 資料集中的相容 Navigator 圖層。

title: 名稱與 ID 獨立開關
text: 名稱與 ID 獨立開關# 開啟文件，從 TTP 側邊欄開啟矩陣。 分別切換 Show names 與 Show IDs。預設顯示名稱，不顯示 ID。 兩者都開啟時顯示 ID 與名稱；都關閉時，技術格子與 tactic 標頭不顯示名稱／ID，勾選、顏色與滑鼠提示仍可使用。 切到 Mini 時，暫時隱藏文字與自訂 tactic 背景，並停用工具列開關；回到 Flat／Side 就恢復原設定。 這是顯示選項，不改變選取、註記或分數。完整 ID／名稱仍保留在提示文字、詳細資料及選取 TTP 的 JSON／CSV。名稱與 ID 開關也會套用到 tactic 標頭。

title: Tactic 標頭背景色
text: Tactic 標頭背景色# 勾選 Tactic background，再用 Header color… 選顏色。選色會一併啟用背景顯示，文字會自動調整對比。取消勾選只隱藏背景，保留已選的顏色。 也可透過 Navigator → Layer settings… → Display 一次編輯顯示開關與六位 #RRGGBB 色碼。Save 會驗證後套用；Cancel 或無效色碼不改變文件。Mini 模式仍可在此分頁預先設定，但畫面會暫時隱藏這些選項的效果。 保存欄位 意義 layout.showName 顯示技術／tactic 名稱 layout.showID 顯示技術／tactic 的 ATT&CK ID showTacticRowBackground 在 Flat／Side 顯示共用 tactic 標頭色 tacticRowBackground 標頭顏色，預設 #dddddd 每層各自保存設定。切換頁籤、複製、Studio 儲存／重開、Navigator 交換、跨領域／版本紀錄與工作階段復原都會保留。修改後須儲存 Studio 文件，才算保存完整編輯狀態。

title: Expand annotated
text: Expand annotated# 按 Expand annotated 會展開具有已註記子技術的家族，並收合其他家族。範圍依目前平台投影，逐 tactic 判定。註解、使用者 Metadata、Links、已設定分數（包含 0）、手動顏色、明確停用狀態與有效來源 Notes 都算註記。只有父技術有註解，不會讓未註記的子技術符合條件。 這個操作展開的是家族：展開後，其他兄弟子技術仍依既有搜尋／隱藏停用篩選顯示，不會被刪除，也不會因此加入選取清單。例如父技術有五個子技術，只有一個有註解，該家族會展開；另一個家族只有父技術有註解，就維持收合。 Expand annotated、Expand all、Collapse all 分別保存 layout.expandedSubtechniques 為 annotated、all、none，會讓文件待儲存，並在圖層切換、Save／重開、Navigator 交換及復原時還原。個別箭頭現在會保留其他家族，保存逐 Tactic 的標準 showSubtechniques，選單切換為 Per-technique · saved；Mini 也遵守明確收合旗標。搜尋可暫時展開命中家族，清空後還原保存狀態，不會保存自動展開。勾選與註記不變。SVG 選 Show children expanded when export opened 可匯出畫面。詳見個別展開範例、全域模式與SVG／Excel 匯出。

title: 註記視覺提示
text: 註記視覺提示# 顯示 意義 黃色底線 非空註解、使用者 Metadata 或來源 STIX Note 藍色底線 已指定 Links 同時兩條線 兩類註記都存在 單純勾選沒有提示線 保留選取標記與只有分隔列的清單不算註記 Flat／Side／Mini 都會顯示提示，包括被選取、被停用或關閉 Show layer colors 的格子。只有分數／顏色／狀態時，可參與已註記家族判定，但不會單獨產生註解／連結線。清除最後一份相關註記後，重新繪製就會移除提示；若來源 Notes 或其他 Metadata 仍存在，清除可編輯註解後黃色線仍可能保留。 滑鼠提示會保留完整識別資訊、註解、Metadata、Links 與來源 Notes。Notes 來自精確領域／版本／資料集內，透過 object_refs 參照該技術的有效 STIX note 物件；撤銷、棄用或無關的參照不顯示。Notes 是唯讀來源內容，不會變成可編輯 Comment 或 CSV 的使用者註解欄。自訂 Bundle 的 Note 不必有 name，使用 abstract 與 content。 Show all layers 會合併相容圖層的提示，不依賴該來源是否有顏色；滑鼠提示會列出來源圖層的註記文字。名稱／ID 與標頭色仍使用目前編輯圖層的設定。

title: 匯出與運作流程
text: 匯出與運作流程# SVG 套用已保存的名稱／ID、Flat／Side 標頭色，以及黃／藍底線；Mini SVG 維持小格子、註記／狀態符號及提示。兩種 Excel 都依已保存開關產生直向標籤矩陣，即使原生畫面是 Mini 也是如此。標頭填色保留設定，黃色下框線代表註解／Metadata，藍色右框線代表 Links；Excel 註解保留完整識別資訊與來源 Notes。詳細資料工作表及 JSON／CSV 的 ID／名稱不受顯示開關影響。 顯示設定在 1/2 驗證 → 2/2 套用 前會顯示 Input files: None／Output files: None；已註記家族展開會在 1/2 解析 → 2/2 更新欄位 前標示沒有檔案輸入／輸出。儲存、匯出與復原仍會先顯示最終／暫存檔絕對位址，再顯示原有階段進度；讀取目錄時會顯示絕對輸入路徑。繪圖或閱讀 Notes 不會寫入 Bundle，無效設定或取消會保留原狀態。

title: 驗證
text: 驗證# 設定 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen 後執行 .venv\Scripts\python.exe -B audit_matrix_display.py。測試會顯示絕對位址及七階段進度，檢查實際提示線像素與清除、tactic 範圍／選取獨立性、Mini／Side、來源 Notes、文件／復原往返，以及 SVG／Excel 讀回。範例與 audit.json 位於 artifacts/matrix-display。 SVG 範例 Excel 範例 English manual

title: Matrix display
text: Matrix Display and Annotation Indicators# See the project README for startup. These features apply to compatible Navigator layers in Enterprise, Mobile, ICS and custom ATT&CK datasets.

title: Independent Names and IDs
text: Independent Names and IDs# Open a document, then open its matrix from the TTP sidebar. Toggle Show names and Show IDs independently. Names default On, IDs Off. Both On shows the ID and name; both Off leaves unlabeled cells and tactic headings. Checkboxes, colors and hover information remain usable. Switch to Mini: labels and custom tactic header backgrounds are suppressed, and the toolbar controls are disabled. Returning to Flat/Side restores the saved choices. These are presentation choices. Full technique IDs/names remain in tooltips, details and selected-TTP JSON/CSV. Name/ID flags also apply to tactic headers. They do not change inclusion, annotations or scoring.

title: Tactic Header Background
text: Tactic Header Background# Check Tactic background, then use Header color… to choose a color. Choosing a color enables its display. Text contrast adjusts automatically. Uncheck the option to hide the background while retaining its color. Alternatively use Navigator → Layer settings… → Display to edit all display flags and the six-digit #RRGGBB header color in one draft. Save applies a validated result; Cancel or invalid color leaves the document unchanged. Display preferences can be configured in this tab even while Mini is active; Mini still suppresses them visually. Stored field Meaning layout.showName Show technique/tactic names layout.showID Show technique/tactic ATT&CK IDs showTacticRowBackground Show the shared tactic header color in Flat/Side tacticRowBackground Header color, default #dddddd These settings are independent per layer. Switching tabs, duplicating layers, Studio Save/reopen, Navigator exchange, domain/version archives and session recovery preserve them. Editing them makes the layer unsaved until Studio Save.

title: Expand Annotated
text: Expand Annotated# Click Expand annotated to expand families whose mapped children have annotations and collapse the other families. It follows the current platform projection and checks each tactic separately. Comments, user Metadata, Links, a stored score including 0, manual color, explicit disabled state and active source Notes count as annotations. A parent comment alone does not qualify an unannotated child. The operation expands a family: once open, its siblings remain visible under the existing search/hide-disabled filters. It does not remove unannotated siblings or add any technique to the selected list. Example: a parent with five children and one child comment opens; another parent with only a parent comment stays collapsed. Expand annotated, Expand all and Collapse all save layout.expandedSubtechniques as annotated, all and none. These mark the file unsaved and restore on layer switches, Save/reopen, Navigator exchange and recovery. Individual arrows now preserve other families and save standard per-tactic showSubtechniques flags, switching the dropdown to Per-technique · saved. Mini honors explicit closed flags. Search may open matching families temporarily; clearing it restores saved states without saving automatic search expansion. Selection and annotations are unchanged. To export this view, choose SVG Show children expanded when export opened. See individual expansion examples, global modes and SVG/Excel exports.

title: Annotation Indicators
text: Annotation Indicators# Visual Meaning Yellow underline Nonempty comment, user Metadata or a source STIX Note Blue underline Assigned Links Both lines Both categories apply No line from selection alone Reserved selection metadata and divider-only lists are ignored Indicators work in Flat/Side/Mini, including selected or disabled cells and when Show layer colors is off. Scores/colors/states qualify for annotated expansion but do not create note/link lines by themselves. Clearing the final comment/Metadata or Links removes its indicator on repaint. A yellow line may remain after clearing an editable comment if source Notes or other user Metadata still exist. Hover to read full identity, comments, Metadata, Links and source Notes. Notes are read-only content from active STIX note objects referencing the technique in the exact domain/version/dataset. Revoked/deprecated Notes and unrelated references are ignored. Notes do not become editable comments or selected-row CSV comment fields. Custom Bundles can contain Notes without a name; they use abstract and content. Show all layers combines indicators from compatible layers independently of colored overlap. The tooltip identifies source-layer annotation text, including a source that has annotations without color. Label switches/header color still come from the active layer.

title: Export and Processing
text: Export and Processing# SVG uses the saved label flags, Flat/Side header background and yellow/blue underlines. Mini SVG keeps compact cells with annotation/state symbols and tooltips. Both Excel modes use a labeled vertical matrix according to the stored flags even when the native view is Mini.
